text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm, guess the Emperor's out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for the president, she's away conducting some student council affairs. Would you like me to take a message?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: No need. It's nothing important. I just thought of something better.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You're pretty much her right hand, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I've been wanting to get to know what sort of individual the Emperor keeps by her side.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …What are you getting at?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: How about we have a little fun?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A race, or anything else of your choosing. Let me get a look at your competitive side.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Thank you for the invitation. Unfortunately, I can't accept a challenge which might be mistaken for a personal conflict.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Students of our status must serve as examples to the younger ones. I would compete with you, but only under the appropriate conditions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! Don't be a bore. I'm just trying to have a little fun. No need to make it a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Or are you trying to run away? At the end of the day, you're just one of her flunkies. Can't do anything without her approval, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now you're looking down on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I know better to not be easily provoked. Also, you're misunderstanding something here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In a proper setting, I, the Empress, would be more than happy to take on a challenge from anybody.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whether it be the great star above long engraved into my memory…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Or the very Emperor who reigns here on earth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! You're just a puppet, aren't you? Fine, then. Can't say I'm not curious.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Face me on the turf someday. Be on your best game, no holds barred.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Gladly.
